328
# A delete made offline around a server loss must stay deleted when another device's Keep or resend brings the node back,
# whether R learns of it from the log, a listing or a restart, and must give way where that device moved the node, changed
# its content, or the user answered Restore. Where another device renamed the deleted folder, the file's record waits for
# the folder and is not downloaded meanwhile, both for a file deleted before its folder and with it, and a file another
# device changed still downloads. Each recovery test is one of those paths and fails on the engine without the record or
# with one of its rules removed; the store tests cover the add-only table on a fresh store and on an upgrade.
# A folder deleted across a rewind to before a file moved into it is recorded only once S drops it, also when that removal
# waited for the file to leave first, so another device's Keep of the folder does not bring it back.
# A record ends as soon as R learns, from a delivered change or a listing, that the server trashed or reshaped the node, so
# a trash and a restore that reach the device before one settle, or a changed node a listing brings, download the node.
# No record is made by a recovery once any of its causes found the store older than the disk, also after a rewind replaced
# that cause: the engine test covers both, and the store tests cover the new halt column on a fresh store, before its
# migration and on an upgrade.
